scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT
Diane Whitmore thrusts her emerald-ringed finger into Cole's chest while twenty-four-year-old nurse Harper grips her sister's medical chart.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: You shameless grease-monkey, dragging the Whitmore family name through hospital dirt with this poverty-stricken nurse!

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Cole paid one hundred thousand dollars for my seventeen-year-old sister Mia's emergency heart surgery, so keep your venom to yourself!

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Quiet down, Mother, before someone from Whitmore Shipping sees us making a public scene.
Twenty-nine-year-old Jake stares at Harper, his gaze lingering on her face longer than simple curiosity allows.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Though I must admit, Cole, marrying a night-shift nurse just to spite your own family is low even for a garage mechanic.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Harper is my legal wife now, Jake, and your opinions don't mean a damn thing to a guy who works for a living.
Seventeen-year-old Mia rests under warm blankets as heart monitors chime steadily beside her bed.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Thank you for standing up to your stepmother, Cole, but why do your wealthy relatives hate a simple mechanic so much?

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Diane only cares about money and status, things that don't matter inside a garage.

scenes.heading: EXT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL ENTRANCE - NIGHT

lines.text: EXT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL ENTRANCE - NIGHT
Fifty-eight-year-old Diane glares back at the glass doors while Jake steps into their private luxury sedan.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Find out everything about that girl, Jake, because if Evelyn hears Cole married a nobody, she'll rewrite the empire's will by sunrise!

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: I'll handle Harper personally, Mother, starting first thing tomorrow morning.
Cole subtly pulls an encrypted Whitmore executive smartphone from his jacket while Harper steps away to adjust Mia's IV drip.
An incoming text message flashes on Cole's screen from eighty-one-year-old matriarch Evelyn: "I know about your contract marriage; bring your wife to the estate."
